checkedAlternates.risk: Chain stitch also exists in surface embroidery.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Here Crochet Chain Stitch (ch) is the foundational single-hook crochet foundation (group-3), distinct from needle embroidery (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Needle tatting can use a hook or long needle to make lace.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Shuttle tatting uses a hand-held winding shuttle to form double-stitch rings and chains (group-1), not a crochet hook (group-3).
